claim: Doses of 3 mg/kg may not effectively prevent acute rejection.
evidence: Typically, the total dose of Thymo-globulin is roughly 6 mg/kg, a dose that has been shown to con-fer adequate lymphocyte depletion and better allograft survival. Thymo-globulin administration causes a cytokine release syndrome, so premedications (acetaminophen and diphenhydramine) are usu-ally given.
